text:
maya: Heads-up — seeing steady memory growth on a streaming chat session that runs a tool loop. KV cache pages keep climbing over ~30min. Anyone else?
eli: saw something similar on canary yesterday. dev note: kv-page refcounts weren't dropping on reused sequences. Do you have pmap/jemalloc dumps? :thinking_face:
maya: quick pmap snapshot I grabbed: 
---
PID 1234: total 1.28G
  anon: 760M
  kv_cache (anon): 420M  (increasing)
  heap: 90M
---
The kv_cache anon region goes up monotonically while sessions are active.
jun: which runtime build? Any recent changes around kernel selection or batching?
maya: master @ 6f3a2c — we merged the kernel-selection prefetch change + batching heuristic tweak last week (prefers larger batches for streaming). Problem starts after that deploy.
eli: I ran pprof on a repro and saw lots of kv_page_pin() / kv_page_hold() calls without corresponding releases. Heap profile snippet: 
```
  45.1%  45.1%  kv_page_pin
  12.9%  58.0%  kv_page_alloc
   9.8%  67.8%  batch_executor::process
```
Looks like pages are being pinned and never returned to freelist under long sessions.
sara: as a temporary mitigation try toggling kv.compact_on_eviction or lowering kv.shard_size. Example: `CONF=kv.compact_on_eviction=true ./start_repro.sh` — that made a difference in my local runs before.
perf-bot: perf/regression-detector: alert: kv_page_residency increased +18% on master vs tag v2026.02 (p95 memory over 1h window). https://perf.internal/reports/18934
jun: assigning this to me + eli to triage. maya can you paste the minimal repro steps and enable jemalloc stats? Also include `--trace-kv` if possible.
maya: repro steps: start a streaming chat session where a tool loop calls an external tool every ~2s for ~45m. Script: `scripts/repro_streamloop.sh --seq 50 --tool-interval 2` — I can also attach a session trace (will DM).
eli: I ran the repro with `--trace-kv` and `mallctl` dumps. Observations: slab_count per-shard grows steadily, reuse hits are low. mallctl('stats') excerpt: `slab.active: 48 -> 120` and `kv.page_refs: increments without matching frees`. Also saw fragmentation spikes when sequence length grows beyond 8k tokens.
jun: quick hypothesis: kernel-selection change started favoring larger KV page layouts for long contexts to optimize prefetch. That reduces page churn when fully used but increases partial-page fragmentation and delays eviction when tool-loop intermittently appends tokens. In combination with batching change (delay eviction by ~5s to avoid jitter), pages are kept pinned longer. I'll add logging in kv_page_release() to confirm whether pages are actually returned to freelist.
maya: noted — the batching tweak explicitly delays eviction to avoid micro-latency spikes; could be the wrong tradeoff for long-lived sessions.
eli: potential quick patch: add a fastpath that forces recyclable flag on pages when reuse ratio < 0.2 for X window even if batch delay is active. Rough pseudocode: `if batch_size > BATCH_TH && reuse_ratio < R: mark_recyclable(page)`
jun: I'll open branch `kv/reclaim-fastpath` and push an instrumented build with extra logging. Smoke tests + staging canary next. ETA ~2h.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of `kv/reclaim-fastpath` to staging started at 1893460000 :rocket:
